categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches cmake/ introspection scripts and carries the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Prevents false-positive feature checks when compilers emit warnings on invalid flags and resolves clang-cl rejection of `-msse4` for SHA-NI. The author notes '-msse4 is merely a synonym for -msse4.2 in both GCC and Clang, but it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend' and identifies this as a prerequisite for #31507.
